connector.name: AWS IoT Core
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for AWS IoT Core: device registry, shadows, jobs, rules, messaging.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package aws-iot-core-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nagarjunr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: AWS session token, for temporary credentials

env.name: AWS_PROFILE
env.description: Named profile from ~/.aws/credentials, as an alternative to explicit keys

env.name: AWS_REGION
env.description: AWS region -- required, AWS IoT Core is regional
